name: shared-expense-app
description: Treasury — shared expense app. This root package holds the Playwright e2e suite; backend/ and frontend/ have their own dependencies.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test:unit: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm --build --no-deps frontend npm test
scripts.test:backend: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm --build backend npm test
